rationale.ai-review: Multi-provider ensemble performs cross-critique and arbitration of AI-generated code fixes.
rationale.remediation-gating: Arbitrator acts as autonomous content gate filtering harmful or scope-expanding proposals.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persists intermediate artifacts and attributions in versioned directories for reproducible human audits.
rationale.risk-quality: Evaluates mitigation of AI fixes introducing unnecessary complexity or breaking existing functionality.
